paper.title_en: Viscous Ghost Dark Energy in $f(Q, L_m)$ Gravity: Observational and Thermodynamic Validity
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the cosmological implications of viscous ghost dark energy in the framework of modified $f(Q,\mathcal{L}_m)$ gravity by considering the linear functional form $f(Q,\mathcal{L}_m)=αQ+β\mathcal{L}_m$. The non-minimal coupling between geometry and matter together with bulk viscous effects modifies the cosmic dynamics, leading to an analytical solution of the background Friedmann equations. Since the expansion history depends only on effective combinations of the model parameters, the observational analysis is performed in terms of the corresponding effective background parameters. We constrain the model using the latest joint compilation of Pantheon+ including SH0ES Type Ia supernovae, Cosmic Chronometers, and DESI baryon acoustic oscillation measurements. The model provides a satisfactory description of the late-time expansion history and reproduces the observed transition from decelerated to accelerated cosmic expansion. A statistical comparison with the standard $Λ$CDM model is performed using the minimum $χ^2$, Akaike Information Criterion (AIC), and Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC). Furthermore, the thermodynamic viability of the model is examined through the evolution of the total entropy, and the generalized second law of thermodynamics is found to remain valid throughout the cosmic evolution.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在 f(Q,L_m) 修正引力框架下研究粘性 ghost 暗能量，结合 Pantheon+、宇宙钟和 DESI BAO 数据进行观测约束，并借助总熵演化检验广义热力学第二定律，涉及热力学有效性这一与黑洞热力学相关的主题，理论建模与统计分析较为完整，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: $f(Q, L_m)$ 引力中的粘性 ghost 暗能量：观测与热力学有效性
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在修正 $f(Q,\mathcal{L}_m)$ 引力框架下，通过考虑线性函数形式 $f(Q,\mathcal{L}_m)=αQ+β\mathcal{L}_m$，研究粘性 ghost 暗能量的宇宙学含义。几何与物质之间的非最小耦合以及体粘性效应共同改变了宇宙动力学，从而导致背景 Friedmann 方程可解析求解。由于膨胀历史仅依赖于模型参数的有效组合，观测分析是借助相应的有效背景参数进行的。我们使用包含 SH0ES 型 Ia 超新星的 Pantheon+、宇宙钟以及 DESI 重子声学振荡测量的最新联合汇编来约束该模型。该模型对晚期膨胀历史给出了令人满意的描述，并再现了观测到的从减速到加速宇宙膨胀的转变。我们使用最小 $χ^2$、赤池信息准则（AIC）和贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）与标准 $Λ$CDM 模型进行统计比较。此外，我们通过总熵的演化检验该模型的热力学可行性，发现广义热力学第二定律在整个宇宙演化过程中始终成立。
